landing.hero.subtitle: Deliver broadcast-quality live scoreboard overlays for your cricket matches. Real-time updates, stunning themes, and seamless OBS integration all in one platform.
landing.features.subtitle: From live scoring to broadcast overlays, KS Live has you covered
landing.feature.liveOverlay.title: Live OBS Overlay
landing.feature.liveOverlay.desc: Professional broadcast-quality scoreboard overlays that integrate seamlessly with OBS Studio.
landing.feature.realtime.title: Real-Time Updates
landing.feature.realtime.desc: Instant score updates powered by Firebase. Every ball and every run reflected live in milliseconds.
landing.feature.themes.title: Premium Themes
landing.feature.themes.desc: Multiple broadcast themes including T20 Neon, World Cup 2026, and Gold Championship.
landing.feature.mobile.title: Mobile Friendly
landing.feature.mobile.desc: Manage scoring from your phone. The compact mini-admin panel works on any device.
landing.feature.team.title: Team Management
landing.feature.team.desc: Full roster management with player profiles, stats tracking, and easy team switching.
landing.feature.secure.title: Secure Access
landing.feature.secure.desc: Firebase authentication with email verification keeps scorer access protected.
landing.how.subtitle: Use the existing admin tools, then plug the live overlay straight into OBS without changing your broadcast layout.
landing.how.step1.title: 1. Start the control panel
landing.how.step1.desc: Open the dashboard, select teams, and begin scoring from the existing admin workflow.
landing.how.step2.title: 2. Overlay updates live
landing.how.step2.desc: The overlay listens to the same live match state used by the dashboard and mini panel.
landing.how.step3.title: 3. Connect OBS
landing.how.step3.desc: Paste the overlay URL into an OBS Browser Source and keep the canvas at 1920x1080 for the intended layout.
landing.how.obsDesc: Paste the overlay URL into OBS Browser Source and keep Width 1920 and Height 1080 for a full-frame transparent overlay.

landing.cta.desc: Join cricket communities using KS Live for professional live scoring and broadcast overlays.
